items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: So the rhythm section was there and we didn't fight with (Shelly) Manne, the drummmer, we catered to him.

ctx.x: Carlos Vidal. So the rhythm section was there and we didn't fight with (Shelly) Manne, the drummmer, we catered to him. He was - he flipped because he says, "Gee, I thought that I was going to have a problem with the conga players", because for him it was something new.
Where did you record that, here or in California?
